name: Conversations help
description: Help mode entries for the Conversations plugin (help@1).
author: Brett

entries.title: Conversations
entries.text: Search everything said in Claude chats, claude.ai exports and transcribed voice sessions, and see the rules ledger every brief carries. Search is local: no AI, no tokens.

entries.title: Read new sessions
entries.text: Reads what is new in every source now instead of waiting for the next round (every 10 minutes).

entries.title: Search what was said
entries.text: Type a few words or a whole sentence; matching passages show newest-ranked first. Tap one to read the whole passage.

entries.title: Source
entries.text: Limit the search to Claude Code chats, claude.ai exports or voice recordings.

entries.title: Kind
entries.text: Show rules, decisions or requests from Brett's words.

entries.title: Add a rule
entries.text: Adds a rule straight to the ledger, pinned to the top of what every brief carries.

entries.title: Add
entries.text: Saves the rule typed beside it.

entries.title: Pin
entries.text: Keeps this line at the top of the ledger in every brief.

entries.title: Unpin
entries.text: Lets this line drop back to its date order.

entries.title: Hide
entries.text: Takes a line that isn't really a rule out of the ledger and out of every brief.

entries.title: Conversations settings
entries.text: Whether briefs carry the ledger, whether headless build runs are indexed, and whether AI answers are allowed.

entries.title: Ledger in every brief
entries.text: On: every rules brief (orchestrator dispatches, headless runs) ends with Brett's standing rules from the ledger.

entries.title: Index headless runs
entries.text: Off by default: build runs are agents talking to themselves. Their verbatim quote from Brett is always kept.

entries.title: AI answers
entries.text: Off by default. On: the context pack also asks the model service for a short answer drawn from the passages, which costs tokens.

steps.say: Everything said with Brett, searchable in one box.
The Rules ledger tab shows what every agent's brief carries from those conversations.
